units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 5:2:3">Y. Peah V, beg. 18ᵈ</cite> <he>רוֹמֵס הייתי זתים וכ׳</he> I was stamping olives with R. Ḥiya &c.; ib. VI, 19ᶜ bot.; ib. VII, end, 20ᶜ.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 66a:11">Kidd. 66ᵃ</cite> <he>רוֹמְסֵם</he> crush them (the Pharisees); a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>רָמוּס</he>; f. <he>רְמוּסָה</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 4:3:12">Y. Ber. IV, 8ᵃ</cite> <he>הר׳ ביד עריצים</he> (the city of Jerusalem) which is trodden down by tyrants.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 16">Lev. R. s. 16</cite> <he>והיה קרון … ומְרַמַּסְתָּן</he> (not <he>ומרמסן</he>) the carriage passed over them and crushed them to death; (<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 4:18">Lam. R. to IV, 15</cite> <he>ומפסקתן</he>).
